corrections: dropdownBehavior overstates mutual exclusion: only the bell (toggleNotif, Nav.dc.html:658) closes the others (menuOpen, searchOpen, openGroup). The account-menu toggle (642) closes nothing else, and opening a nav group (559) closes menu+search but leaves the notif panel open. 'Opening notif/menu closes others' is only true for the notif side.

contentBackground column metrics are not universal: Home.dc.html:63 and Quotes.dc.html:55 use max-width:1240px with padding:24px 28px 64px as claimed, but Flame Tests.dc.html uses max-width:1200px and padding:24px 30px 64px. Scope the 1240px/28px claim per-screen rather than as a shell constant.

companyName is settings-overridable, not just a prop default: renderVals uses (AppSettings.get().companyName) || props.companyName || 'Peak Systems Group' (Nav.dc.html:485; settings.js defines companyName 'Peak Systems Group' in localStorage-backed defaults). The spec mentions the AppSettings override only for accent.

Bell/to-do count is NotifPrefs-filtered: notifications() drops groups where NotifPrefs.get(me)[group.key] === false (Nav.dc.html:475-477), so the bell badge is the per-user pref-filtered sum of items, not the raw sum. Spec omits this.
Re-render triggers: in addition to the listed rss-* events + resize, the nav schedules a one-shot re-render 60ms after mount (Nav.dc.html:341) so store-backed badges populate after page scripts load.

Screenshot-visible rendering artifact not in the spec: at the 924px capture width (wide mode) the tab row has no overflow handling (the .nav-rowscroll scrollbar-hiding CSS at Nav.dc.html:37-38 is defined but never used in markup), so the right cluster overlaps the tabs — in Quotes.png the 'Synced' chip covers 'Service ▾/General', in Flame Tests.png it covers 'General'. Worth noting if the shell will be rebuilt at intermediate widths.

accountMenu.panel spec text is truncated at 'top:42px;' — the actual panel (Nav.dc.html:183) is: position:absolute;top:42px;right:0;width:238px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8eaee;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.22);overflow:hidden;z-index:70;color:#16181d. Menu contents: user header (34px accent avatar, name 13px/600, role 11px #9aa0ab), 'Switch user' roster section (max-height:172px scroll, 26px avatars with per-user colors, accent ✓ on current user), 'Account settings' link, 'General settings' link with ADMIN chip, then 'Send feedback' and 'Sign out' (#8c919c) below a #f0f1f4 divider.

Trivial omission: topLevelTab.base in source also carries resets text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent (Nav.dc.html:537) — include them if the tabs are rebuilt as <a>/<button> elements.
